The eight-witness slate locked Thursday testifies in the classified session — NIST Director Locascio, the ODNI cyber lead, the NSA Cybersecurity Directorate director, a Microsoft Threat Intelligence Center representative, the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency Director, the Federal Communications Commission Public Safety and Homeland Security Bureau Chief, the Department of Energy Cyber Security, Energy Security, and Emergency Response Assistant Secretary, and the Department of Treasury Office of Cybersecurity and Critical Infrastructure Protection Assistant Secretary.
